_comment: DK CAD Mobile release manifest. Lives in the dk_cad Pages repo ROOT as mobile-update.json; the app reads it from https://dheerajkum7g7-eng.github.io/dk_cad/mobile-update.json with the raw.githubusercontent copy as a mirror. The APK is stored as 2 MB PARTS because the publishing network's proxy rejects large authenticated uploads; GitHub does not join them, mobile.html does. To ship a new build: run publish-mobile.ps1, which rewrites version/size/sha256/partCount here. Keep this file SEPARATE from the desktop's update.json.
_urlNote: The SAME release asset the Google Sites download button points at, so there is one download in the world, not two. Release MV / DKCadMobile.apk is replaced in place on every version - the website link never changes. mobile.html on Pages is a BACKUP route for networks where github.com is blocked (this office's own laptops get 403 there).
notes: See where you are ON the drawing. Press the new GPS button and a blue dot marks your own position on the plan, with a circle showing how accurate the fix is - and it moves as you walk, like Google Maps. It works on any georeferenced drawing anywhere in the world: the UTM zone and hemisphere are worked out from your own position, nothing is fixed to one country. On a local site grid it says so rather than placing you somewhere wrong. The UTM panel also gains a Here button, which drops your current position into the coordinate list and copies its Easting/Northing and latitude/longitude straight to the clipboard. The coordinate and distance labels are CAD text again: the box in the bottom bar is now a HEIGHT IN DRAWING UNITS, so type 1 on a metre survey and the label is one metre tall - it grows and shrinks with the drawing as you zoom instead of sitting over it. Everything from 4.9 - the UTM point picker, snapping inside blocks, the INS snap and the slim three-row toolbar - is unchanged.
